independentChecks: Angle fixture: XZ fasteners extend along -Y from 23 to 11 mm; exact volume equals pi*2^2*12 mm3.
Heat exchanger: all 16 YZ tubes extend along +X from -74 to +74 mm and match pi*(4.3^2-3.2^2)*148 mm3.
Precision stack: spacer and washer volumes match their analytical annular cross-section times height.
XY plate bases start at Z=0 mm in projects 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10.
Reviewed valve, drive-column and guard-post stacks are seated. Rotary spindle follows the tested +2 mm platter-thickness edit.
Volume-neutral jaw_span edit moves Jaw 1 by -2 mm and Jaw 2 by +2 mm; changed-body bounds are recorded.
Gripper: at jaw_span 56 and 60 mm, native rebuild solved palm/jaw hole axes coincide in XY with both pin axes; native pin meshes span palm/jaw Z ranges and match pi*3^2*34 mm3.

reproducibility.kind: Recorded snapshot from temporary authoring and native-verification scripts, which are not distributed. This is not an automated continuous test gate.
reproducibility.stalenessRule: If a project file SHA-256 differs from projectFileSha256, its recorded evidence is stale. Recheck with the recorded app/kernel version and browser workflow before updating claims.

scopeLimits: Static component layouts only: no joints, motion, assembly transforms, threads, load ratings or manufacturing qualification.
Obvious reviewed seating and collision issues were corrected, but full inter-body fit/interference is not qualified. Separate-file mode checks each mesh, not cross-body overlaps.
One documented primary parameter edit per project was verified. Arbitrary edits and parameter ranges were not qualified.
Development native browser checks. No application runtime code changed.
